# ParityAnomalousSemimetal

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A semimetal whose band structure exhibits a parity anomaly, leading to a quantized anomalous Hall conductivity in the clean limit. Provides a topological platform for dissipationless transport and Berry-phase engineering relevant to neuromorphic and topological computing.
